name: Sidorovich
source:
Specialty: Gangster
Location: Earth (Eastern Europe)
Race: Human

Sidorovich, a man of 42 years, is a product of an unforgiving environment. He is not your typical space pirate. His origins trace back to an old-world culture rooted in Eastern European territories of Earth. His thick accent, a relic of his Ukrainian heritage, gives him a unique, intimidating aura in the otherwise cosmopolitan space society. His most distinctive feature, however, is his right arm. Not made of flesh and bone, it's an impressive piece of cybernetics. Sleek and golden, and lit occasionally by the eerie glow of its internal mechanisms. Years ago, before he became notorious in the fringe territories, Sidovich was part of a crew of asteroid miners in the belt of Yaroslav. A violent clash with Bozzar Raiders cost him his arm and almost his life. When he came through, he took control of his mining crew, transformed them into a gang, vowing to never work another day in his life. Since then, he's become a feared figure in the territories, a symbol of survival and defiance.
